journeyId.title: Journey Id
journeyId.description: journeyId output of the most recent LoanSeva action; empty on the first call.

sessionId.title: Messaging Session Id

message.title: Customer Message
message.description: The customer's latest message copied character for character. Never paraphrase, translate or summarise it, and never turn it into Yes, No or an option number: the journey decides what it means.
